narrative.overview: A bright, airy landing page whose credibility IS the aesthetic: every claim is verifiable, every tradeoff stated in place, every machine fact set in mono. Bricolage Grotesque display over a plain system body, one blue accent, an emerald signal color, and a true dark theme mirrored through CSS variables.
keyCharacteristics: Zero third-party origins: self-hosted fonts, no analytics, CSP 'self' only.
Class-only styling; no inline styles ever.
One page, real anchors, progressive disclosure via details elements.
Honest copy: no em dashes, no hype adjectives, tradeoffs beside features.

rules.name: The Color-Is-State Rule
rules.body: If something is colored, it carries meaning (status, action, focus). Decoration stays neutral.

rules.name: The Machine-Speaks-Mono Rule
rules.body: Commands, ports, model names, and hashes are always mono; prose never is.

dos: Do keep every port, command, and model name in IBM Plex Mono.
Do state the honest tradeoff next to every capability claim.
Do use classes for all styling; the CSP forbids inline styles.
Do mirror any new light-theme value with a dark-theme counterpart.
Do keep sequences numbered only when order genuinely matters.
donts: Don't add any third-party origin (fonts, scripts, images, embeds).
Don't use em dashes in copy, hype adjectives, or urgency patterns.
Don't ship SaaS gradient-wash, vanity metrics, or glassmorphism.
Don't color decoration; color is state, action, or focus.
Don't let the footage mock's reds/teals leak into page chrome.
